_meta.description: Shared design tokens across all Mexzungu Group web properties. Source of truth for color, typography, spacing, radii. Prevents sub-brand drift between mexzungu.com and aistudio.mexzungu.com and future subdomains.
rules: Any addition, rename, or value change requires Anselmo approval
Sub-brand accents (like accent_terminal) capped by usage rule in the token definition
No inline hex values in any CSS file that consumes this token set
Migration status: aistudio.mexzungu.com consumes these tokens as of 2026-09-10. mexzungu.com main site still uses inline hex in style.css. Migration is next task.

allowed_uses: one code-strip element or link accent

fonts.display_aistudio: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

quarterly_cross_brand.scope: side-by-side visual audit of aistudio.mexzungu.com vs mexzungu.com; drift patched in same commit
